findings.what: exp13, the ILP disappearance/appearance sweep. OLD VERDICT (RESULTS.md exp13 row; CONTEXT l.87, l.130, A9 l.164): 'keep d2/a0'. On 48 videos with gap5+direct8 post-processing and div weight 1.2: d1/a0 0.9149, d2/a0 0.9158 (reference), d3/a0 0.9110, d2/a0.5 0.9216. Later filed as 'v2.1 config; does not transfer'. Knobarms v_2 (28 Sep) called it 'a local lab sweep on the old pipeline, no public read'. That let tonight's risk stack (exp89q/exp89r, 00:05 UTC) take ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25 'from the metric formula (fewer nodes = +0.0007 bonus)'. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The same old lab got the sign of the sibling knob right. exp12 said div 1.2 -> 0.6 is +0.011 locally; probe 50 (div 0.4) read +0.002 publicly. That is the only ILP knob with both a lab read and a public read. (2) The knobarms v_3 algebra says the ILP solution depends only on S = A + Dis and on the fork threshold Div - A. So exp13's a0.5 arm (S 2.5, threshold 0.7) is the 'DIS up at a low fork threshold' case, which is where DIS 2.25 now sits on K (S 2.25, threshold 0.4). Against exp12 div 0.6 (S 2, threshold 0.6, 0.9271) it lost 0.0055, and it had half the ILP division TPs (12 vs 24). (3) Today's dummies show the fork loss. exp89p -> exp89q (DIS 2.25 on K+SEC) takes safe divisions from 69 to 67. On exp70g, where there are no ILP forks, forks do not change (81 -> 81). The same step also costs 83 readmitted nodes, 26 gap closes, 5 gapfill nodes and 7 divins-eligible triples. Final nodes fall by 834; 432 of the 1,153 raw-node drop would have been removed by the short-track filter anyway. NEW VERDICT: the old closure partly revives, as evidence against DIS 2.25, not as a block. A parabola through exp13 at threshold 1.2 puts the optimum at S ~1.66: S 2.25 gives -0.0007 and S 1.75 gives +0.0003. At a low fork threshold the old lab also loses ILP forks. The dummy-clip GT lab (2,127 GT edges) cannot resolve this: exp89q vs exp89p has identical TP/FP/FN and +0.0004 from the node bonus only; exp88a vs exp70g is -0.0008 (1 TP, 2 FP). Expected public effect of DIS 2.25 on K: about 0, range -0.001..+0.0007. The +0.0007 'mechanical bonus' premise holds only if the removed nodes carry no TP edges on the unseen embryo.
